subject: Renewal & capacity prioritization — AmpliHealth
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Hayes <caroline@amplihealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal & capacity prioritization — AmpliHealth

Hi Caroline —

Hope you had a smooth summer. As we approach AmpliHealth's renewal window in October, I'd like to align on three things so we can scope the right term and capacity options:

1) Stakeholder list — who from your side will own commercial/technical/procurement sign-off?
2) Capacity ask — is the 2x throughput bump we discussed still the target, or do you want a staged ramp?
3) Timing for a QBR-style renewal sync — propose week of Sep 11–15 for a combined exec + technical session.

Attached is a short one-pager that outlines the options we typically present (term lengths, staged capacity, conservative vs. aggressive billing). If it helps, we can surface a couple of pricing scenarios in advance of the QBR.

Next steps I propose:
- If you confirm stakeholders, we’ll send a calendar invite for the QBR and a short pre-read.
- Internal teams (CS + Sales + Solutions) will prepare a runbook and delta-impact on latency/cost.

Do you have a procurement contact we should loop in? Also, any constraints around timeline (board approvals, fiscal cutoffs) we should be aware of?

Thanks — looking forward to coordinating.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: AmpliHealth_Renewal_1-pager.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Aug 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity prioritization — AmpliHealth

Sofia — thanks for kicking this off. A couple quick internal notes:

- We should propose both a 12- and 24-month option. AmpliHealth has signaled they like multi-year discounts, but they also want predictability.
- Ben: can you run a quick capacity forecast for the requested 2x uplift and a staged 3-step ramp? I want to see lane-by-lane GPU impact.
- Karthik: please confirm whether we can offer a conservative burst pool for their busiest batch windows without moving them to Dedicated immediately.

I’ll volunteer to lead the exec portion of the QBR; Sofia, if you can own the buyer-stakeholder invite list I'll draft the pre-read.

-Marissa
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the note and the one-pager — useful framing. Quick answers:

- Stakeholders: myself (Head of ML Ops), Miguel Torres (CTO), Linda Park (VP Ops), and procurement (procurement@amplihealth.com).
- Capacity: We want to target the 2x uplift but prefer a staged approach: 1.25x immediate, 1.75x in quarter 1 post-renewal, then 2x by month 6.
- Timing: Sep 12 or Sep 14 afternoon (EST) works best for the QBR. We have a board review at the end of Sep, so locking terms by Sep 22 would be ideal.

I'll loop in procurement now; they'll push any standard terms back to you. I’ve attached the RFP that outlines our compliance ask and procurement cadence.

Caroline
Head of ML Ops, AmpliHealth
caroline@amplihealth.com

Caroline — great, thanks for the clarity and the RFP. Sep 12 afternoon EST should work. I booked a 45-minute slot for Sep 12 at 3:00pm EST tentatively and included a Doodle link for alternate slots if that helps: https://doodle.com/poll/amplihealth-renewal.

Planned agenda (45m):
- 10m Executive context and business objectives (Marissa + Caroline)
- 15m Capacity plan and staged uplift (Ben + AmpliHealth engineering)
- 10m Commercial terms and preferred term-lengths (Sofia + procurement)
- 10m Next steps: rollout timeline, legal, and checkpoints

Next steps on our side:
- I’ll circulate a 2-page pre-read that includes modeled cost delta for 12m vs 24m and the staged capacity plan.
- Ben will produce a short tech-run impact note (latency, burst behavior, KV cache expectations).
- We’ll flag any redline items in the draft contract and share early with procurement so legal cycles are shorter.

Related HubSpot record: https://hubspot.company.com/deal/8421 — I’ve attached the draft contract v2 for internal review. Could procurement confirm whether they need an SOC 2 addendum or extra retention language?

Best,
Sofia

Quick internal update —

Sofia/Marissa: I ran the 2x uplift simulation (attached). Short summary:
- Staged approach looks feasible with a small uptick in tail latency during peak windows; recommend holding burst pool at 20% for first 90 days.
- If AmpliHealth opts for 24-month term we can offer a 7% effective discount vs. 12-month.
- Legal: please loop in Contracts (legal@redwood.com) early; there are three retention points in the RFP that will need explicit language.

I’ll finalize the tech note before the QBR and attach the simulation results to the pre-read.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
